blocks.text: DynamoDB TTL uses an epoch-seconds attribute for expiry. Deletion happens later in the background, not at an exact second.

The background deletion service is asynchronous and is not simulated by DynamoDB Local.

blocks.text: This item shape has an expiry field. A real table must enable TTL on that field; DynamoDB Local does not perform the real background TTL deletion service.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not rely on TTL to hide a value immediately at its expiry time. Applications may need to filter expired values while deletion is pending.
